payload.name: Curiosity as a mediator of impulsive purchase intention
payload.fact: Perceived uncertainty in blind box products has a positive impact on consumers' impulsive purchase intentions, with curiosity acting as a mediating variable.

provenance.title: Research on the effect of uncertain rewards on impulsive purchase intention of blind box products
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results show that perceived uncertainty has a positive impact on consumers' impulsive purchase intentions, in which curiosity plays a mediating role
